[[File:Dantooine-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The planet Dantooine, which shared its name with "Dantooine: stone."]]
"'''Dantooine: stone'''" was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] created by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Artist/Legends|painter]] [[Val Isa/Legends|Val Isa]], who [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]<ref name="Lessons">{{FFG|story=Lessons from the Past|book=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook}}</ref> of [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]]. It shared its title with the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

"Dantooine: stone," "[[Bespin: air]]," "[[Koler: fire]]," and "[[Mon Calamari: water]]" were the only works by Isa whose titles were mentioned in the records of the [[Phelar University Archive|Archive]] of [[Phelar University]] on the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]<ref name="Lessons" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], although no images of the paintings were included.<ref name="Lessons" />

{{RPG|"[[Lessons from the Past]]"}}
At one point during that conflict, a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals researching Isa in the Archive discovered the record mentioning her paintings, including "Dantooine: stone."<ref name="Lessons" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
"Dantooine: stone" was mentioned in "[[Lessons from the Past]]," a [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure included in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system. In the adventure, the player characters can optionally discover information mentioning the painting. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Lessons" />
